sources.note: Finds that a fact successfully unlearned from a multimodal model's final answer can still be reproduced in its reasoning trace, far more in natively RL-trained models than in their base versions, and uses the token-level entropy signature RL leaves behind as a training-free control signal for redirecting the trace at decoding time.
sources.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

sources.note: Reframes unlearning in reasoning models as an intervention on the CoT itself, having the model generate logically valid counterfactual traces and iteratively preference-tuning toward them.
sources.title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization

instructions:

`related` is the one part of the note nothing can work out on its own.
